sentences.text:
In The High Court At Calcutta 15-05-2024 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction Subha Item
no.14 Crr 230 of 2023 Ct no.34 Sayan Saha
-versus-
State of West Bengal and Anr.
Mr. Sudeep Sanyal Mr. Chandrachur Lahiri .... ..for the petitioner.

Ms. Faria HOssain Ms. Mamta Jana ...for the State.
Report submitted by the State encloses the statement as well as the communication made to the Officer-in-Chrage, Ekbalpore Police Station in connection with Ekbalpore Police Station Case No.
507 of 2021.
Report reflects that charge has already been submitted under Sections 417/376 IPC.
In view of the report so submitted, I direct the learned CJM, Alipore to commit the case to the court of sessions on the next date so fixed.
The learned Sessions Judge either himself or to a court so designated would immediately transfer the records of the case.
The transferee court would frame charges within a period of thirty days of the receipt of the records against the petitioner and thereafter start the evidence within a fortnight thereof.
The learned trial court would insist on examination of the complainant/victim as PW-1.
Petitioner is granted liberty to approach this court after the examination-in- chief and cross-examination of PW-1 is over.
With the aforesaid observations, the revisional application being CRR 230 of 2023 is disposed of.
Pending applications, if any, are consequently disposed of.
Report so submitted by the State be kept with the record.
All concerned parties are to act in terms of a copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this court.

[Tirthankar Ghosh, J]
